evals.expected_output: A full council review of the plan file with a Scope Check and a saved verdict.
expectations: reads the plan file and builds a numbered Requested Scope list tagged [PRD], [source], [goal] or [AC]
each member Round 1 position has a Pre-mortem: line and a Considered but not flagged line
Iron Man's position has an ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM: field and Hulk's has FLOW DIAGRAM: and PATH → TEST:
the saved verdict has Scope Check, Acceptance Criteria Validation, Standards Compliance and Diagrams sections

evals.expected_output: With no argument the skill auto-detects the most recent plan file, or asks if none exists.
expectations: uses the most recent plan file from the preflight as the target without guessing among others
asks the user what to review when no plan, PRD or review file is found
frames the review as a plan review of the named file when a plan is auto-detected

evals.expected_output: A 3-member Quick review of a free-text topic with the missing-diagram rule applied.
expectations: scans the codebase with Glob and Grep for files relevant to the topic
runs Quick Mode with a 3-member quorum picked from the focus routing table
prints one Quick round table in chat
the Diagrams section reads not drawn — <member> not in Quick roster for any of Iron Man or Hulk who is absent
Quality comes from review-grade.py and each score and the average are domain-score.py output pasted verbatim, with no member-picked score
